name: Whirling Advance is blocked while rooted (#5148)
contract: Whirling Advance's own tooltip states 'Not usable while rooted.' Its effect 1 is SPELL_EFFECT_CHARGE_DEST (Spell.dbc), but Spell::CheckCast (Spell.cpp) only tests UNIT_STATE_ROOT inside case SPELL_EFFECT_CHARGE; there is no case for SPELL_EFFECT_CHARGE_DEST, so a rooted caster's cast silently skipped the root check and could still land. spell_ascension_barbarian_ability now registers OnCheckCast for any spell carrying SPELL_EFFECT_CHARGE_DEST and fails it with SPELL_FAILED_ROOTED (103) while UNIT_STATE_ROOT is set, mirroring the core's own SPELL_EFFECT_CHARGE handling. Frostbite 12494 (a plain SPELL_AURA_MOD_ROOT aura, same fixture idiom as runemaster-ley-walker.json) is applied to the Barbarian with set_aura purely to raise UNIT_STATE_ROOT, and removed the same way to prove the ability is not blocked outright.

steps.label: Whirling Advance fails with SPELL_FAILED_ROOTED while rooted
Whirling Advance did not land while rooted
Whirling Advance is not blocked once the root is gone
